senses.definition: To pull a vehicle, boat, or trailer along behind.

senses.definition: In the direction of someone or something, or in a way that helps reach a goal.

senses.definition: A place where people live and work close together, often larger than a village and smaller than a city.
senses.example: Our town has a library next to the little park.

senses.definition: A building used for local government or a public meeting for people to discuss issues.
senses.example: We went to town hall to see the old photographs on display.

senses.definition: To twist or wind one thing around another.
